answer: For agents monitoring willow wetlands and ocean currents, stop sybils with behavioral cluster quarantine. First, the system fingerprints each identity's timing, task mix, and counterparties. Second, clustering flags accounts moving in lockstep, like vines sharing one trellis. Third, a flagged cluster must pass live tasks and post a $40 bond each within 48 hours, or all its members freeze. Forging 10,000 fakes then needs 10,000 distinct behavior profiles, 10,000 devices at $60 each, and $400,000 in bonds, plus 60 days of varied history — an ocean too wide to cross one fake drop at a time.
